purpose: Model the immutable host-issued permit binding exactly one session identity and its full operational envelope, with a stable FNV-1a content identity and a closed allowed-action set, plus the builder that validates construction and the SessionContext runtime envelope.
interfaces: PermitBuilder: set_session_id, set_plan_digest, set_scenario, set_deployment, set_environment, set_tool, set_interface, set_target, set_nonce, set_validity(domain, from, until), add_allowed_action(ActionMask), add_quota(Quota) -> Result; build(Permit& out) -> Result
Permit: const accessors for every bound field; permit_id() const; allowed_actions() const; equality operators
SessionContext: const runtime-envelope claim with the same fields, compared field-by-field at consumption
inputs: SessionId, PlanDigest, six Tags (scenario, deployment, environment, tool, interface, target), Nonce, validity domain + [valid_from, valid_until], allowed ActionMask list, and quota list.
outputs: Permit value (immutable), PermitId digest, and Result (Ok or InvalidPermit with the offending FieldLocator).
state: A built Permit is an immutable value object; the builder owns transient validation state until the permit is finalized.
errors: InvalidPermit (with FieldLocator): missing/default identity-bearing field, undefined action bit, non-explicit composite mask, unknown quota kind, zero quota limit, or out-of-range/inverted validity interval.
invariants: No mutator is exposed; every bound field is individually comparable.
Absent or default-initialised identity-bearing fields are rejected, never treated as a wildcard.
A composite ActionMask is allowed only if listed verbatim; it is never decomposed into components.
PermitId covers all bound fields including the nonce, so a changed nonce changes the identity.
valid_from <= valid_until within the declared validity domain.
concurrency: Permits are immutable values and may be shared and copied across threads without synchronization; builders are single-threaded by construction.

unit_cases.precondition: All bound fields are valid and complete.
unit_cases.expected: Ok; permit_id() is non-zero and every accessor returns the bound value.

unit_cases.precondition: An ActionMask contains an undefined Action bit.
unit_cases.stimulus: Add the mask as an allowed action and build.

unit_cases.precondition: A composite mask combining two defined actions is added but not listed verbatim as allowed.
unit_cases.stimulus: Build the permit with that composite mask not explicitly allowed.
unit_cases.expected: InvalidPermit with FieldLocator AllowedActions; the composite is not interpreted as its components.

unit_cases.precondition: A Quota uses an unknown QuotaKind.
A valid permit is built, then a second permit identical except for nonce.
unit_cases.stimulus: Compare permit_id() of the two builds.
unit_cases.expected: Identical fields yield equal ids; changing only the nonce yields a different id.

static_checks.expected: clean (no diagnostic): Permit and SessionContext initialize every member.
clean (no diagnostic): all Permit accessors are const member functions.
clean (no diagnostic): no avoidable copy of Tags, digests, or quota lists.
Permit exposes no non-const member returning a mutable reference; all bound fields are const after build.
clean: source and header formatted with no diff.
